## Mathematical Model

The equation of motion of a single-degree-of-freedom system is:

$$
m\ddot{x}(t) + c\dot{x}(t) + kx(t) = f(t)
$$ {#eq-motion}

where $m$ is the mass, $c$ the viscous damping coefficient and $k$ the stiffness. In the frequency domain, @eq-motion becomes:

$$
H(\omega) = \frac{1}{k - m\omega^2 + \mathrm{i}\,c\omega}
$$
